title: ZnS QDs and Nanomaterials Toxicity Studies
summary: This cluster revolves around the study of ZnS quantum dots (QDs) and their interactions with various biological entities. ZnS QDs are characterized by dynamic light scattering and induce cell death. They are also found to modulate the mitochondrion and cause hypersensitivity in pos5Δ. Additionally, ZnS QDs are exposed to yeast strains and pos5Δ, and treated with BY4742. The toxicity of ZnS QDs is compared to CdS QDs, which have a higher tolerance in glr1Δ. Nanomaterials, including ZnS QDs, are the subject of a study published by Guisbiers Gregory. The cluster also includes various sequencing and bioinformatic analyses methods used to study the effects of ZnS QDs on biological processes.
